arg.name: image
arg.description: The image topic. Should be remapped to the name of the real image topic.

arg.name: use_camera_info
arg.description: Indicates that the camera_info topic should be subscribed to to get the default input_frame_id. Otherwise the frame from the image message will be used.

arg.name: debug_view
arg.description: Specify whether the node displays a window to show edge image

arg.name: queue_size
arg.description: Specigy queue_size of input image subscribers

arg.name: quality_level
arg.description: Parameter characterizing the minimal acceptance quality of image corners.

arg.name: min_distance
arg.description: Minimum possible Euclidean distance between the returned corners.

arg.name: block_size
arg.description: Size of an average block for computing a derivative covariation matrix over each pixel neighborhood.

arg.name: harris_k
arg.description: Free parameter of the Harris detector
